name: Miracle
author: Darksidewalker (DaSiWa)
note: Hybrid v3 "Miracle": MiniMax's fl2va and ref2va merged and fine-tuned in one file, for text, first/last frame and references; int8 ConvRot (needs a recent ComfyUI). Recommended: res_multistep or euler / simple, shift 10–12 video and 3–5 sound, 20–25 steps.
